case_number: 2024 INSC 979; CRIMINAL APPEAL NOS. 5267-5268 OF 2024 (Arising out of S.L.P. (Crl.) Nos. 8239-8240 of 2018)
summary: Alibi fabrication via bogus excise case; time-distance impossibility (160 km between Firozabad-Gwalior within 1 hour); High Court improperly quashed Firozabad murder investigation; inherent powers invoked to stay excise proceedings for preventing conflicting judgments; respondent's role in creating false alibi confirmed via witness statements; sanction for prosecution under S.197 CrPC delayed; criminal conspiracy under IPC Sections 120-B, 302, 307 quashing improper.
legal_provisions_cited: Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 s.482, s.161, s.197
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment quashing murder investigation set aside; excise case stay maintained; respondents to face trial for conspiracy and murder charges.
